description: Model ids accepted by Anthropic's Claude Code CLI on the Anthropic API (the --model flag / settings). Source: Claude Code model configuration docs plus Anthropic's current and legacy Claude model overview; provider-specific Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry ids are intentionally excluded. Newer models carry a minimum CLI version (Fable 5.1 needs v2.1.255+, Opus 5 v2.1.219+, Sonnet 5 v2.1.197+, Fable 5 v2.1.170+). Claude Mythos models are excluded because they require invitation-only Project Glasswing access and are not offered in the normal model picker.
